test_requirements.primitive_boundary: fixed_skill_fixture.py is an action primitive; reading Skill bytes is not Skill behavior qualification or coverage of all cases

evidence_and_result.before_each_effect: fresh typed current checks and exact remote durable Intent readback; recheck after publication
evidence_and_result.unknown: no redispatch or capacity release; exact target reconciliation then only authorized safe stop
evidence_and_result.decision: PENDING -> RUNNING -> DECISION_RESERVED; reserve all immutable Test/Evidence digests once; controlled signing Outbox; fresh final authorization/revocation/expiry/drift recheck before terminal CAS; one GA has one signed GRR.
evidence_and_result.output_authority: qualification test evidence only; no ACTIVE/Entry/model/production authority
evidence_and_result.success: All 19 applicable tests require sufficient real evidence for the identical exact inputs and independent oracle review; a single fixture read/write is never 19-case PASS.
